R0282.title: Investor Cognition Manipulation
R0282.definition: Attackers influence investors and trading strategies through narrative hype, theme rotation, emotional anchoring, FOMO creation, or consensus traps.
R0282.description:
Investor cognition manipulation occurs in investment communities, social media, research groups, live streams, short videos, and trading-discussion spaces. Attackers build viral narratives around concepts, stories, leading-stock rotation, reverse-limit-up inducement, emotional anchoring, or so-called story alpha to drive investors into chasing prices, cutting losses, rotating positions, or entering high-risk trades.

This differs from ordinary opinion. The focus is profit-seeking through communication timing, group psychology, and trade timing. It can combine with market information manipulation, ranking misleading, and liquidity deception to create a chain of hype, liquidity attraction, and exit or reverse trading.
R0282.influence: It induces investors to chase rallies, sell panics, rotate wrongly, absorb exits, or enter high-risk trades, causing losses and market disruption.

observables: Social discussion and trading volume spike together
Multiple accounts spread similar narratives toward the same instrument
Theme rotation coincides with large exits, reverse trades, or liquidity withdrawal
Complaints point to narrative-induced trading or copy-trading
